_comment: claude-auto-advance config. Generic + public-safe — NO secrets live here (creds stay in each CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.credentials.json, managed by the claude-acct-* tools). Copy to ~/.config/claude-auto-advance/config.json and edit.

interactive._comment: Interactive VS Code/CLI sessions: SWAP-ONLY by design (Claude Code has no supported hands-free interactive resume — see README §Verification). On limit we swap creds instantly + notify; you press Up+Enter to continue on the fresh account.

headless_jobs._comment: Each entry is a FULLY-AUTO supervised loop. `claude-auto-advance run-job <name>` ensures a non-maxed account, runs resume_cmd, and on a limit-stop swaps creds + relaunches `claude --continue` until the job finishes. config_dir is the account profile this job rides (its creds get hot-swapped). project_dir is where the conversation lives (so --continue resumes THAT project's last session).
headless_jobs.name: example-autopilot
